caption: The drawing depicts a wooden object with four legs, resembling a workbench or table. The left half consists of a rectangular, shallow tray with dividers, and the wood in this section is a light, slightly yellowish-brown color with visible grain and several dark screws or fasteners. Attached to the tray, on the right, is an elongated, irregularly shaped plank, also made of wood but appearing slightly more greenish and weathered, with rounded edges and a more natural, unshaped form. This section is supported by its own leg, which is attached at an angle. The remaining three legs underneath the tray section are straight but uneven, and show visible grain, knots, and darkened marks. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color, and in the bottom right corner, there is a small hand-written signature.
title: Shoe Bench
